description: Create and update lists, indexes, write rules and flows to match a schema sync document. All or nothing: if any change would be refused, nothing is written and the plan says why. Run plan_schema_sync first and show the user the plan. With prune, it can also delete lists and indexes, so it needs confirmDestructive: true. Needs sync-schema plus the permission for each change; flows need a token that is allowed everything. Index builds it starts run in the background (wait_for_index). Suggest the user commits the document, so it can be deployed with jsonpad sync-schema. 1 request.

allowDestructive.description: Allow a prune to delete lists that have items, and guard indexes

allowRebuild.description: Allow changes that rebuild an index in a list that has items (the index is unusable until it's rebuilt)

confirmDestructive.description: Confirm a prune, which can delete lists and indexes (after showing the user the plan)

document.description: The schema sync document: { "$schema": "https://jsonpad.io/schema/sync-v1.json", "scope": "my-app", "lists": { "<pathName>": { name, schema, rules, rulesTests, indexes: { "<pathName>": { pointer, valueType, ... } } } }, "flows": { ... } }. File references (rulesFile and so on) aren't supported: put the contents inline

prune.description: Also delete the lists and indexes this document's scope manages but no longer declares. Needs a scope

name: apply_schema_sync
title: Apply a schema sync
